title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: closing a decided claim on a cover
content:
## Situation of use and capability

This operations reference belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. The desk agent uses close_cargo_claim_a3572c28 once a claim on a cover has been decided, by settlement approval or by rejection. One call changes the cover's status from the open-claim state to the closed-claim state. It books no money, changes no claim file and pays nothing. Afterwards the cover shows a closed claim and can take notice of a further loss on the same shipment.

## How it is invoked

close_cargo_claim_a3572c28 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the desk agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| cover_id | Cover reference number of the cargo cover whose decided claim is being closed, as returned by the cover lookup | Identifier |

## Return

On success the tool returns: status ("claim_closed" when the cover was updated); cover_id (the cover closed); cover_status (the cover's status after the call, claim_closed).

## Input and return illustration

| Input | Return |
|---|---|
| cover_id of a cover whose claim has been decided | status claim_closed; the same cover_id; cover_status claim_closed |

## Contract Q&A

**Does the call pay an approved settlement?** No. It books no money and pays nothing.

**Does the call change the claim file?** No. It changes only the cover's status.

**What can the cover take after the call?** Notice of a further loss on the same shipment.
